original.target_description: MORN2 SNP rs3099950: allele-frequency ratio for ME/CFS cases versus Kaviar reference controls in Perez et al. Table 1. The located outcome is SNP frequency, not a direct functional assay of the gene.

n.sample_role: ME/CFS participants and Kaviar reference controls; SNP-specific analytic denominators not established
n.exclusions: HIV infection or dementia precluding full participation/consent excluded at eligibility; per-SNP exclusions and missingness not reported.
n.location: p. 1, Abstract, Methods (overall cohort only); p. 5, Table 1 (no analytic denominators)
n.quote: 383 ME/CFS participants underwent DNA testing using the commercial company 23andMe.

es.location: p. 5, Table 1, MORN2 / rs3099950 row, Frequency ratio column

p.location: p. 5, Table 1, MORN2 (rs3099950) row; no p-value printed for this allele-frequency ratio

replication.target_description: MORN2 SNP rs3099950: allele-frequency ratio for ME/CFS cases versus openSNP 23andMe controls, reusing original case frequencies. This is a reanalysis, not a new case sample.

n.sample_role: 23andMe control participants with data for this SNP; ME/CFS analytic denominator not reported
n.exclusions: Per-SNP missingness; exact exclusions not documented. Ratios with fewer than 20 control subjects were considered invalid.
n.location: p. 3, Table 1, MORN2 (rs3099950) row, N / 23andMe control column

es.metric: ratio of allele frequency in CFS patients to control subjects
es.location: Article p. 3, Table 1, MORN2 / rs3099950, Ratio of CFS to CONTROL, With 23andMe column

p.location: p. 3, Table 1, MORN2 (rs3099950) row; no p-value printed for this allele-frequency ratio

reported_success.location: Article p. 2, Results, paragraph naming EFCAB4B, LINC01171 and MORN2
reported_success.quote: Only three snps of 50 remained, on genes EFCAB4B, ... LINC01171, and MORN2, that could be shown to meet the ... original criterion of at least double in CFS patients compared to ... a comparable 23andMe control, all hovering at a ratio of about ... 2.0.

notes:
Titles and DOIs verified from the primary PDF title pages. Original table is p. 5; replication Table 1 is p. 3 (the supplied replication p. 5 locator does not exist in the four-page article). Both print frequency ratios, not odds ratios; printed metrics retained without conversion. No SNP-specific p-values are printed. Original total cohort of 383 is not used as analytic n because SNP-specific denominators cannot be established. Replication n is the printed per-SNP control participant count only, not a combined case-control n. Replication author-derived table ratios use the original reported case frequencies with new controls; ALFA is a separate comparison. Success follows the authors' gene-specific narrative verdict, not a significance inference. For MORN2, the printed 23andMe ratio is 1.98, despite the narrative saying it remained at least twice as frequent; retained without reconciliation. ALFA ratio is 1.81.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Unique named gene/rsID identifies target independently. Primary comparable-23andMe control column prints 1.98; metric is allele-frequency ratio, not converted to OR. Additional ALFA control prints 1.81.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly name this gene among three retaining original descriptive frequency-ratio criterion. Successful records narrative verdict only, not statistical significance. Table 1 prints 1.98 for MORN2 with the 23andMe control, whereas authors include MORN2 among the three meeting at-least-double criteria and describe ratios as about 2.0. Printed value and narrative verdict are both preserved; no rounding correction applied.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Unique MORN2 / rs3099950 row directly matches the named gene. Retained the printed Frequency ratio; requested OR is not printed and no conversion is made.
